result: Narrowed; original node status retained. For every natural-number energy list P, every integer weight function w with w(0)=1, and all zero-mode multiplicities b and f, the difference of weighted sums over b zeros followed by P and f zeros followed by P equals b-f. It is independent of w. A zero difference does not imply absence of zero modes.
proof_boundary: Pairing is supplied by the shared spectral list; this does not derive that pairing from an arbitrary supercharge, spectral decomposition on a Hilbert space, the analytic exponential trace, or the ground-energy theorem. The full imported Witten-index statement remains open here.
